name: renaissancedev
description: Renaissance is a open source wiki engine that is currently in development. Renaissance has several planned features including Markdown-based pages, an admin panel which allows you to manage plugins and schedule backups, and all the other bells and whistles you would expect in a standard wiki engine. If you're curious about specific features, there is a roadmap available on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/JTMQq7mg22).
